metadata.question: Was the surface water extent along the borders of Craighead and Jackson counties in northeastern Arkansas on April 13, 2025 greater than on April 13, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-1 GRD (cloud-free) over a 1-day window on each target date (2023-04-13, 2025-04-13) for the Craighead–Jackson county border strip (2 km corridor via buffered intersection). If no images that day, widen to ±3 days. If still empty, fall back to Sentinel-2 SR Harmonized with cloud masking and NDWI; same windows.
2. Masking strategy: 
   - Sentinel-1: no cloud mask; ensure positive values before log; water mask via VV_dB < -16 and VH_dB < -22.
   - Sentinel-2: QA60 cloud/cirrus mask; NDWI > 0.2 for water.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error:
   - Immediately check collection sizes (C1 on both primary and fallback empty, after trying both S1 and S2).
   - Compute valid pixel counts after masking base bands (VV or B3). If 0, C2.
   - If any area value is null/NaN or exceeds region area by >10%, C3.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function eeGet(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.evaluate((v, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(v)));
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const counties = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/Counties')
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('STATEFP', '05')); // Arkansas
  const craighead = ee.Feature(counties.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Craighead')).first());
  const jackson = ee.Feature(counties.filter(ee.Filter.eq('NAME', 'Jackson')).first());
  const craigGeom = craighead.geometry();
  const jackGeom = jackson.geometry();
  // 2 km corridor centered on shared border via buffered intersection
  const borderStrip = craigGeom.buffer(1000).intersection(jackGeom.buffer(1000), 1);
  const regionAreaM2 = ee.Image.pixelArea().clip(borderStrip)
    .reduceRegion({reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: borderStrip, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9})
    .get('area');

  // 2. Acquisition and processing functions
  function s1CollectionWin(region, start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
      .filterBounds(region)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VH'));
  }
  function toDB(img) {
    // log10 on positive values only
    const vv = img.select('VV').updateMask(img.select('VV').gt(0));
    const vh = img.select('VH').updateMask(img.select('VH').gt(0));
    const vvDb = ee.Image(10).multiply(vv.log10()).rename('VV_dB');
    const vhDb = ee.Image(10).multiply(vh.log10()).rename('VH_dB');
    return vvDb.addBands(vhDb);
  }
  async function analyzeWithS1(dateStr, region) {
    const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const pStart = d;
    const pEnd = d.advance(1, 'day');
    const fStart = d.advance(-3, 'day');
    const fEnd = d.advance(4, 'day');
    const colP = s1CollectionWin(region, pStart, pEnd);
    const colF = s1CollectionWin(region, fStart, fEnd);
    const sizeP = await eeGet(colP.size());
    const sizeF = await eeGet(colF.size());
    if ((sizeP || 0) === 0 && (sizeF || 0) === 0) {
      return {status: 'C1', attempt: {s1Primary: sizeP, s1Fallback: sizeF}};
    }
    const useFallback = (sizeP || 0) === 0;
    const col = useFallback ? colF : colP;
    const windowStr = await eeGet(ee.String(ee.Date(useFallback ? fStart : pStart).format('YYYY-MM-dd'))
      .cat('..')
      .cat(ee.Date(useFallback ? fEnd : pEnd).format('YYYY-MM-dd')));
    const mosaic = col.median().clip(region);
    const bandsDb = toDB(mosaic);
    const vvDb = bandsDb.select('VV_dB');
    const vhDb = bandsDb.select('VH_dB');
    const validCount = await eeGet(vvDb.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('VV_dB'));
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', attempt: {s1Primary: sizeP, s1Fallback: sizeF}, used: {dataset: 'S1', window: windowStr, validCount: validCount || 0}};
    }
    const waterMask = vvDb.lt(-16).and(vhDb.lt(-22));
    const waterAreaM2 = await eeGet(ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area'));
    return {
      status: 'OK',
      Dataset: 'S1',
      window: windowStr,
      s1Primary: sizeP || 0,
      s1Fallback: sizeF || 0,
      validCount: validCount || 0,
      waterAreaM2: waterAreaM2 || 0
    };
  }

  function s2CollectionWin(region, start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
      .filterBounds(region)
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80));
  }
  function maskS2(img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
    const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    return img.updateMask(mask);
  }
  async function analyzeWithS2(dateStr, region) {
    const d = ee.Date(dateStr);
    const pStart = d;
    const pEnd = d.advance(1, 'day');
    const fStart = d.advance(-3, 'day');
    const fEnd = d.advance(4, 'day');
    const colP = s2CollectionWin(region, pStart, pEnd);
    const colF = s2CollectionWin(region, fStart, fEnd);
    const sizeP = await eeGet(colP.size());
    const sizeF = await eeGet(colF.size());
    if ((sizeP || 0) === 0 && (sizeF || 0) === 0) {
      return {status: 'C1', attempt: {s2Primary: sizeP, s2Fallback: sizeF}};
    }
    const useFallback = (sizeP || 0) === 0;
    const col = (useFallback ? colF : colP).sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE');
    const img = ee.Image(col.first()).clip(region);
    const windowStr = await eeGet(ee.String(ee.Date(useFallback ? fStart : pStart).format('YYYY-MM-dd'))
      .cat('..')
      .cat(ee.Date(useFallback ? fEnd : pEnd).format('YYYY-MM-dd')));
    const cloudPct = await eeGet(img.get('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE'));
    const masked = maskS2(img);
    const validCount = await eeGet(masked.select('B3').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('B3'));
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      return {status: 'C2', attempt: {s2Primary: sizeP, s2Fallback: sizeF}, used: {dataset: 'S2', window: windowStr, cloudPct: cloudPct || null, validCount: validCount || 0}};
    }
    const ndwi = masked.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI');
    const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.2);
    const waterAreaM2 = await eeGet(ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area'));
    return {
      status: 'OK',
      Dataset: 'S2',
      window: windowStr,
      s2Primary: sizeP || 0,
      s2Fallback: sizeF || 0,
      cloudPct: cloudPct || null,
      validCount: validCount || 0,
      waterAreaM2: waterAreaM2 || 0
    };
  }

  async function analyzeDate(dateStr, region) {
    const s1 = await analyzeWithS1(dateStr, region);
    if (s1.status === 'OK') return {date: dateStr, method: 'S1', meta: s1};
    if (s1.status === 'C2') return {date: dateStr, status: 'C2', s1Meta: s1};
    // fallback S2 if S1 had C1
    const s2 = await analyzeWithS2(dateStr, region);
    if (s2.status === 'OK') return {date: dateStr, method: 'S2', meta: s2, s1Attempt: s1};
    if (s2.status === 'C2') return {date: dateStr, status: 'C2', s1Attempt: s1, s2Meta: s2};
    return {date: dateStr, status: 'C1', s1Attempt: s1, s2Attempt: s2};
  }

  try {
    const regionArea = await eeGet(regionAreaM2);
    console.log(`Region (border strip) area km2: ${(regionArea / 1e6).toFixed(2)}`);

    const d2023 = await analyzeDate('2023-04-13', borderStrip);
    const d2025 = await analyzeDate('2025-04-13', borderStrip);

    function printSummary(res) {
      if (res.method === 'S1' && res.meta) {
        console.log(`${res.date} S1 imgs: primary=${res.meta.s1Primary} fallback=${res.meta.s1Fallback}; Used S1 win: ${res.meta.window}`);
        console.log(`${res.date} validPix: ${res.meta.validCount} water_km2: ${(res.meta.waterAreaM2 / 1e6).toFixed(3)}`);
      } else if (res.method === 'S2' && res.meta) {
        const s1P = (res.s1Attempt && res.s1Attempt.attempt) ? res.s1Attempt.attempt.s1Primary : 0;
        const s1F = (res.s1Attempt && res.s1Attempt.attempt) ? res.s1Attempt.attempt.s1Fallback : 0;
        console.log(`${res.date} S1 imgs: primary=${s1P || 0} fallback=${s1F || 0}; S2 imgs: primary=${res.meta.s2Primary} fallback=${res.meta.s2Fallback}; Used S2 win: ${res.meta.window}`);
        console.log(`${res.date} validPix: ${res.meta.validCount} S2 cloud%: ${res.meta.cloudPct !== null ? res.meta.cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'} water_km2: ${(res.meta.waterAreaM2 / 1e6).toFixed(3)}`);
      } else if (res.status === 'C2') {
        console.log(`${res.date} No valid pixels after masking (processing).`);
      } else if (res.status === 'C1') {
        console.log(`${res.date} No images found in date/location (both S1 and S2).`);
      }
    }

    printSummary(d2023);
    printSummary(d2025);

    // Error conditions precedence
    if (d2023.status === 'C1' || d2025.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (d2023.status === 'C2' || d2025.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Extract water areas and validate
    const area2023 = (d2023.meta && d2023.meta.waterAreaM2) ? d2023.meta.waterAreaM2 : null;
    const area2025 = (d2025.meta && d2025.meta.waterAreaM2) ? d2025.meta.waterAreaM2 : null;
    if (area2023 === null || area2025 === null || !isFinite(area2023) || !isFinite(area2025)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    // Sanity check against region area
    if (area2023 < 0 || area2025 < 0 || area2023 > regionArea * 1.1 || area2025 > regionArea * 1.1) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Areas km2 - 2025: ${(area2025 / 1e6).toFixed(3)}, 2023: ${(area2023 / 1e6).toFixed(3)}, Δ: ${((area2025 - area2023) / 1e6).toFixed(3)}`);

    // Final Answer
    if (area2025 > area2023) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
